record.paper_title: Open Problems in Heavy Quarkonium Physics
record.context_brief: χc inclusive decays and αs extraction
record.original_question: What are the next-to-leading-order contributions in the heavy-quark velocity expansion to the inclusive decay widths of the χcJ states, and once those contributions are computed, can the improved decay-width ratios be used to determine αs at the charm-mass scale? The paper explains that existing data are already sensitive to NLO corrections in the Wilson coefficients, but that a consistent extraction of αs requires the velocity-expansion corrections because they may be as large as those perturbative corrections.

evidence.quote: Clearly the data have become sensitive to NLO corrections and may be used, in principle, to determine αs at the charm-mass scale.

Before this, a necessary step is the calculation of the decay widths at next-to-leading order in the velocity expansion, since these contributions are potentially of the same magnitude as NLO corrections in the Wilson coefficients.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Within the nonrelativistic QCD (NRQCD) factorization framework, the inclusive decay width of a P-wave charmonium state $\chi_{cJ}$ ($J=0,1,2$) into light hadrons admits a double expansion in the strong coupling $\alpha_s$ and the squared heavy-quark relative velocity $v^2$. Schematically, $\Gamma(\chi_{cJ}\to\text{light hadrons}) = \sum_{n} \frac{F_n^{(J)}(\alpha_s,\mu)}{m_c^{d_n-4}}\,\langle\chi_{cJ}|\mathcal{O}_n|\chi_{cJ}\rangle$, where the short-distance Wilson coefficients $F_n^{(J)}$ are computable perturbatively in $\alpha_s$ and the long-distance matrix elements $\langle\chi_{cJ}|\mathcal{O}_n|\chi_{cJ}\rangle$ scale with definite powers of $v$. The leading-order contributions involve a color-singlet P-wave matrix element together with a color-octet S-wave matrix element. The next-to-leading-order (NLO) corrections in $\alpha_s$ to the Wilson coefficients $F_n^{(J)}$ are known.

(a) Determine the complete set of NLO corrections in the heavy-quark velocity expansion (i.e. the $\mathcal{O}(v^2)$ relativistic corrections) to the inclusive decay widths $\Gamma(\chi_{cJ}\to\text{light hadrons})$ for $J=0,1,2$. This requires identifying all NRQCD operators of the appropriate dimension contributing at relative order $v^2$, computing their short-distance coefficients, and estimating the associated long-distance matrix elements.

(b) Using the improved theoretical predictions for the ratios of decay widths $\Gamma(\chi_{c0})/\Gamma(\chi_{c2})$ and related ratios, in which several universal matrix elements cancel, perform a consistent extraction of $\alpha_s$ at the charm-mass scale $\mu = m_c$, demonstrating that the $\mathcal{O}(v^2)$ velocity-expansion corrections are under control and comparable in magnitude to the NLO $\alpha_s$ corrections in the Wilson coefficients.
artifact.status_search_result: Partial progress has been made: NLO QCD corrections to the Wilson coefficients for $\chi_{cJ}$ inclusive decays are known, and various relativistic ($v^2$) corrections to related $\chi_{cJ}$ processes (e.g. exclusive $\chi_{cJ}+\gamma$ production, electromagnetic decay ratios) have been computed. However, no single, widely accepted complete calculation of all $\mathcal{O}(v^2)$ velocity-expansion corrections to the inclusive light-hadron decay widths of $\chi_{cJ}$ combined with a consistent extraction of $\alpha_s(m_c)$ from the resulting ratios could be verified. The full programme described therefore appears not yet realized in a definitive form; current status is best characterized as unknown/partially addressed.

status_evidence.title: Improved determination of inclusive electromagnetic decay ratios of heavy quarkonium from QCD
status_evidence.snippet: Improved determination of inclusive electromagnetic decay ratios of heavy quarkonium from QCD.
status_evidence.claim: Inclusive electromagnetic decay ratios of heavy quarkonium have been improved using NRQCD, addressing a related but distinct sector of the problem.

status_evidence.title: Relativistic corrections to exclusive chi_cJ + gamma production from e+e- annihilation
status_evidence.snippet: all leading relativistic corrections to exclusive χ_cJ+γ production... contributions induced by octet operators with a chromoelectric field
status_evidence.claim: O(v^2) relativistic corrections to chi_cJ processes including chromoelectric color-octet operators have been computed in some channels, but not in a definitive complete form for inclusive light-hadron decays.

status_evidence.title: Corrections For Two Photon Decays of chi_{c0} and chi_{c2} and Color Octet Contributions
status_evidence.snippet: Corrections For Two Photon Decays of chi_{c0} and chi_{c2} and Color Octet Contributions
status_evidence.claim: NLO and color-octet corrections to chi_c decays have been studied in the two-photon channel, indicating ongoing work but not full inclusive light-hadron completion.
